info.title: LAHAP API
info.description:
LAHAP — SME catering subscription & fulfillment platform. Generated from `contract.prisma` and the decisions in AGENTS.md (2026-11-02).

**Conventions**
- Base URL ends in `/api`. JSON everywhere except uploads (`multipart/form-data`) and `/realtime/stream` (SSE).
- Success: `{ "data": …, "meta"?: … }`. Lists: `{ "data": [...], "meta": { page, limit, total, totalPages, hasNextPage, hasPrevPage } }` with `?page=&limit=` (max 100).
- Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "issues"? } }`. 400 validation, 401 missing/invalid token, 403 role not allowed, 404 not found (also for other users' resources), 409 uniqueness/still referenced, 422 business rule or state (cut-off passed, wrong slot status, unavailable package).
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`; each operation lists its roles in `x-roles`. Refresh with `/auth/refresh` (rotates the refresh token); `/auth/logout` revokes the refresh token. Access tokens are stateless and stay valid until they expire.
- **Terminology:** `Subscription` = PRD "Pesanan" (order); `Order` = PRD "Slot" (one portion on one schedule); `MenuSchedule` = "Jadwal Menu".
- Status values are Indonesian and case-sensitive (`Siap Diambil` has a space). Derived labels (`displayStatus`, meal-time `range`, `isAvailable`, `doneOnline`) are computed, never stored.
- Money is Rp as a JSON number with up to 2 decimals. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` and times `HH:mm` in Asia/Jakarta; timestamps are ISO 8601 Asia/Jakarta wall-clock time with its offset and milliseconds (`2026-11-03T08:00:00.000+07:00`).
- Photos: upload via `POST /files`, send the returned key as `photoKey`; responses add a short-lived signed `photoUrl`. A new `photoKey` must be in the entity's folder (`menus/`, `packages/`, `ingredients/`, `tiers/`, `obstacles/`) and exist in storage, otherwise 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

Returns a new token pair and sets a new `lahap_refresh` cookie. Reads the refresh token from the body, or from the `lahap_refresh` cookie when the body has none. Refresh tokens are stored server-side and **rotated**: each refresh revokes the presented token, so keep only the newest one. Presenting a token that was already revoked (rotated or logged out) is treated as theft: every refresh token of that user is revoked and the user must sign in again. 401 `MISSING_TOKEN` when neither is sent; 401 `INVALID_TOKEN` when the refresh token is invalid, revoked or unknown, or the user is gone or inactive; 401 `TOKEN_EXPIRED` when it has expired.

**Public** (no token).

Revokes the refresh token and clears the `lahap_refresh` cookie. Reads the refresh token from the body, or from the `lahap_refresh` cookie when the body has none, like `/auth/refresh`. No access token is needed, so logout still works after the access token expired. Access tokens are stateless and stay valid until they expire (`expiresIn`), so the client must discard it. Always returns 204, also without a token or with an invalid, expired or already revoked one.

Server-Sent Events (UC-12, UC-42). Events are scoped to the user: customers get their own slots, notifications and relevant announcements; couriers their slots; kitchen and admins every slot change. The stream starts with a `retry: 5000` reconnect hint, and a `: ping` comment is sent every 25 s. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` is not replayed; refetch state after reconnecting.

The server closes the stream when the access token expires (`JWT_EXPIRES_IN`): refresh the token and reconnect. A user keeps at most 5 open streams (opening a sixth closes the oldest), and the server refuses new streams with 503 when it holds 1000.

post.description:
**Roles:** `CUSTOMER`.

Computes slots, allergy warnings, delivery availability, discounts and the total without saving anything (UC-07–UC-09, UC-41, UC-49). Discounts are rounded down to a whole rupiah. `Mingguan`/`Bulanan` may start in a week or month already under way: only the published slots after today are taken. `delivery.available` is `false` until a pin is sent. 422 `INVALID_STATE` when the package is unavailable (`package is not available`) or doesn't offer the period or a meal time, a chosen slot is unpublished or of another package (`slot is not available`), a slot is today or earlier (`cut-off has passed`), or nothing is left to order (`no slots to order`). 400 when a weekly order doesn't start on a Monday or a monthly one on the 1st.

**Roles:** `CUSTOMER`.

Creates the order (`Pending`), its slots (`Terjadwal`) and a `Pending` payment (UC-10). With `MIDTRANS`, open `paymentSession`; the webhook moves it to `Success`. The Midtrans transaction expires after `paymentTimeoutMinutes`, together with the order (BR-20). With `CASH` (Offline only), the admin verifies at the cashier. Unpaid orders expire after `paymentTimeoutMinutes`. When discounts bring the total to 0, no gateway is called: the payment is saved as `Success` with method `FREE` and the order is `Success` at once (`paymentSession` is `null`).

Discounts are rounded down to a whole rupiah. The promo code is checked again inside the write, so two orders racing for a code's last use can't both get it.

422 `INVALID_STATE` messages: `online orders cannot be paid in cash`, `delivery is not available for this address`, `promo code quota is exhausted`, `promo code has already been used`, `promo code no longer exists`, plus the preview's (`package is not available`, `package does not offer this period`, `slot is not available`, `cut-off has passed`, `no slots to order`, `package does not offer delivery time HH:mm`). 502 when Midtrans fails; nothing is saved.

Quotes switching a paid (`Success`) order's `Terjadwal` slots from `effectiveFrom` onward (default: the first switchable slot after today) without saving anything (PRD §7.5). `Dilewati` slots are left as they are. For pick-up → delivery (`isDelivery: true`), delivery is quoted at today's rates; past the max distance, `delivery.available` is `false` (not an error). 400 when `effectiveFrom` is today/earlier (`must be after today`) or after `endDate` (`must not be after the order's end date`), or when `isDelivery: true` is missing the delivery address or pin. 404 for another customer's order. 422 when the order is not `Success` (`subscription is not paid`) or has no switchable slot on or after `effectiveFrom` (`no slot can switch method`).

**Roles:** `CUSTOMER`.

Switches a paid (`Success`) order's `Terjadwal` slots from `effectiveFrom` onward (PRD §7.5):
- **Delivery → pick-up (`isDelivery: false`):** switches the slots at once (`isDelivery = false`, `deliveryFee = 0`, `courierId = null`), updates `subscription.isDelivery = false`, and creates a `Success` change with `needsRefund = amount > 0` (`payment` and `paymentSession` are `null`). The customer, admins (when a refund is due) and couriers who lost slots are notified.
- **Pick-up → delivery (`isDelivery: true`):** quotes today's delivery rates. When `amount > 0`, opens a `Pending` `DELIVERY_SERVICE_UPGRADE` payment and a `Pending` change, leaving the slots as pick-up until the payment succeeds; when `amount = 0` (inside the free radius), applies the switch at once without a payment.

404 for another customer's order. 422 `INVALID_STATE` messages: `subscription is not paid`, `no slot can switch method`, `another delivery method change is waiting for payment`, `delivery is not available for this address`, `online orders cannot be paid in cash`, `slots changed, try again`. 502 when Midtrans fails; nothing is saved.

**Public** (no token).

Called by Midtrans only. The signature is verified (401 on mismatch, 400 on a malformed payload). `order_id` is our `payment.id`. The payment row is locked while the change is decided, so repeated or concurrent notifications are applied once. Mapping: `settlement`/`capture` (accept) → payment `Success` with `paidAt`, the reported channel as `method` (`MIDTRANS_<PAYMENT_TYPE>`), and the order `Success` in the same transaction; `pending` and a `capture` flagged `challenge` → no change (logged); `deny`/`failure`/`cancel`/`expire` → payment and order `Expire`; `refund` → payment `Refund`, `needsRefund = false`, and a still-`Success` order becomes `Dibatalkan`. A payment that arrives after the order was expired or cancelled is recorded as `Success` with `needsRefund = true` and the admins are notified; the order stays closed. Answers 200 for an unknown `order_id` or an amount that differs from the payment (logged, nothing changes), so Midtrans stops retrying. Configure this URL as the Payment Notification URL in the Midtrans dashboard.

**Roles:** `ADMIN`.

Reads a market shopping receipt photo with `ReceiptExtractor`, matches purchased lines against existing ingredients, converts each quantity from the unit printed on the receipt to the ingredient's unit (kg↔gram, liter↔ml; a line without a printed unit counts in the ingredient's unit), and returns `{ items: [{ id, name, unit, stock }] }` where `stock` is `currentStock + convertedQuantity` (ready to submit directly to `PATCH /admin/ingredients`). Lines that match no ingredient, have no valid quantity, or carry a unit that can't be converted (e.g. `pcs` for an ingredient in kg) are left out. Reading a receipt takes about 20 seconds. Nothing is saved.

userId.description: Required when `target = CUSTOMER`; must be an active customer.

deliveryTimes.description: `Mingguan`/`Bulanan`: meal times repeated on every service day.

isDelivery.description: `true` = courier delivery (needs address + pin within max distance), `false` = pick-up.

MidtransNotification.description: Midtrans HTTP notification (only the fields the backend reads are listed). Verified with `signature_key = SHA512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + serverKey)`, and `gross_amount` must equal the payment's amount. Mapping of `transaction_status` to stored statuses: `settlement`/`capture` (accept) → `Success`, `pending` and `capture` with `fraud_status = challenge` → unchanged `Pending`, `deny`/`failure`/`cancel`/`expire` → `Expire`, `refund` → `Refund`.

status_code.description: HTTP-like status code as a string.

gross_amount.description: Amount as a string with 2 decimals.

IncomeReport.description: Gross income (UC-31) from `Success` orders created in the period, including verified cash. `Expire` and `Dibatalkan` are excluded; skipped slots still count (UC-44).
